replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by transforming variables into orthogonal components (principal axes). 1) Standardize your dataset. 2) Compute covariance matrix, then eigenvectors/eigenvalues of it. 3) Sort by eigenvalue magnitude; retain top components for a lower-dimensional projection. Don’t worry—it’s linear algebra with clear steps! Visualizing 2D/3D reduces complexity.
